row.notes: Recomputes the results-screen button/option flags from game mode (+8), session (+0x18), career save (+0x28) and weekend state. Writes bytes +0x58 (mode-type lookup of *(mode+0xf40)+0x1a8 via table 0x14571d424), +0x59..+0x66 (visibility/enable flags: e.g. +0x5b session type in 15..17 mask 0x38000, +0x5c type 15..17 and not online, +0x63/+0x65 session type 1 or 2 = practice, +0x64 replay save available via FUN_142c4b8e0, +0x66 gated by feature flag bit 0x100), +0x50 career component ptr, label string +0x68 (lng_advance_to_qualifying / lng_save_full_race_replay / ?) and tooltip +0x78 (lng_advance_to_next_practice / lng_advance_to_qualifying / lng_tooltip_advance), then pushes the tooltip to the UI binding at +0x48. Current session index/type read from weekend struct (+0x220 array of 0xa0, index +0x238, type at +8). Good hook to force advance/replay buttons.
